nodes.summary: Native app, Scene, AppKit integration, dependency composition, Menu Bar, and overlay ownership.
Project-first SwiftUI and TCA slice; it owns Project navigation and transient UI state.
Typed ProjectClient command and observation facade plus persistence port.
Project, Membership, typed IDs, validation, and current legacy domain surface.
GRDB schema, transaction, observation, repository, and migration adapters.
MainActor observable dependency container that constructs GRDB-backed local capabilities and ProjectClient.
Sendable typed client for snapshots, Local Project creation, and Project selection.
ProjectPersistence adapter that commits Project, owner Membership, and selected Project records.
Current canonical local database for Project workspace records and legacy Todo/Memo records.
Remaining stub-backed public/group dependency container; not the Project-first data path.
macOS application repository with one Xcode project and four local Swift packages.
Local Swift package that produces the Common utility module.
Foundation and OSLog-oriented utilities shared by current packages and the app host.
Local Swift package currently named TodoMateDomain and producing Domain plus Application modules.
Domain entities, repository protocols, policies, and legacy use cases.
Typed application client surface currently containing ProjectClient and ProjectPersistence.
Local Swift package that owns GRDB and current external/local adapter implementations.
GRDB database, records, migrations, repositories, and legacy adapters.
Command-line probe for the narrow GRDB read-only projection path.
Local Swift package for the Project-first TCA slice and shared UI-test identifiers.
SwiftUI screens and TCA reducers for the current Project-first app path.
Shared AccessibilityID contract linked by Presentation and the native UI-test target.
Native macOS application target and composition root.
Native unit-test bundle depending on the application target.
Native UI-test bundle linking the UI-test contract product and targeting TodoMate.app.
Filesystem source folder for the native application host and remaining legacy UI.
Xcode file-system-synchronized group named TodoMate; it is not itself a module or target.
TCA root state for launch phase, Project sidebar, optional selected Project workspace, and snapshot Effect lifetime.
TCA owner of Project list/selection plus create-sheet draft, operation, and failure state.
TCA owner of the selected Project projection and transient Todo/Memo/Chat section selection.
MainActor Observation store for legacy local Todo observation and mutation; still injected into Menu Bar and overlay surfaces.
MainActor Observation store for legacy local Memo observation and mutation; still constructed by the app host.
Legacy Observation navigation selection and Home mode owner retained in source but not instantiated by current MainView.
SwiftUI App root that owns the Menu Bar scene, main Window scene, and host dependency lifetime.
Parallel MenuBarExtra surface receiving TodoBoardStore from the host.
Main macOS Window scene that composes MainView and environment dependencies.
Thin native-host bridge that passes ProjectClient into the Project-first package screen.
Project-first NavigationSplitView root and TCA Store owner.
Project list, selection, create action, and create-sheet presentation.
Render-focused Projects list receiving values and narrow callbacks from its Screen.
Local Project name form presented as a sheet by ProjectSidebarScreen.
Selected Project title, lifecycle, section picker, and current placeholder destinations.
Render-focused workspace content receiving Project values and section callback.
Current Todo section placeholder; Project-scoped Todo content is not yet implemented in this route.
Current Memo section placeholder in the Project-first workspace.
Current Chat section placeholder in the Project-first workspace.
AppKit overlay surface retained beside the SwiftUI Project route and registered with WindowManager.
Source-retained Private/Public navigation Sidebar; MainView no longer composes it.
Source-retained Board/Calendar Home surface not composed by the current MainView.
Source-retained Memo grid/detail surface not composed by the current MainView.
Source-retained Group feed wrapper using legacy Session/Todo/Message stores; not composed by current MainView.
